recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中布滿大型母細胞，染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質藍灰色，並夾雜嗜酸性骨髓細胞、嗜鹼性顆粒細胞及一個分裂中細胞，符合 CML 急性轉化。
features: Predominance of large blasts with fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Some blasts with irregular, folded or elongated nuclei
A mitotic figure with condensed chromosomes (upper left)
Admixed granulocytic precursors including an eosinophilic myelocyte and a cell with coarse dark basophilic granules
Few red cells; scattered free granules in background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous large blasts with fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with irregular or folded nuclear contours. A mitotic figure is present, and scattered residual granulocytic precursors include an eosinophilic myelocyte and a basophil-type cell. Findings are consistent with blast phase of CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, with lineage to be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Inv(16) AML shows abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and monocytic differentiation, and lacks BCR-ABL1.
Myelomonocytic blasts show NSE positivity and monocytic immunophenotype, whereas diagnosis here rests on CML history and BCR-ABL1.
Chronic phase marrow shows a full maturation spectrum with myelocyte and neutrophil predominance, not sheets of blasts.
